headword: {業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}

definitions.gloss: business alliance; operational partnership; business tie-up
definitions.explanation: A cooperative arrangement between companies to collaborate on specific business operations, share resources, or jointly develop products or services. Less binding than a merger or acquisition.

examples.japanese: {二社|にしゃ}が{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: The two companies formed a business alliance.

examples.japanese: この{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}により、{両社|りょうしゃ}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{活|い}かした{新|あたら}しいサービスが{生|う}まれる。
examples.english: Through this business alliance, new services leveraging both companies' technologies will be created.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}の{企業|きぎょう}との{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}を{進|すす}めて、{販路|はんろ}を{拡大|かくだい}したい。
examples.english: We want to expand our sales channels by advancing business alliances with overseas companies.

notes:
A formal business term frequently seen in news articles and corporate announcements. Business alliances allow companies to cooperate without the complexity of mergers or capital investment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}を{結|むす}ぶ: to form a business alliance
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce a business alliance
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}{契約|けいやく}: business alliance agreement
- {包括的|ほうかつてき}{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}: comprehensive business alliance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {資本|しほん}{提携|ていけい}: capital alliance — involves investment between companies
- {合併|がっぺい}: merger — complete combination of companies
- {協業|きょうぎょう}: joint operations — working together on specific projects
